title: Delaware Office Registry
method: Hand-curated. Every holder comes from the office's own official page or roster, fetched on the checked date. Party is the label on the Delaware Department of Elections list for the office's last regular election, or the official roster. Term lengths cite the U.S. Constitution, the Delaware Constitution or the Delaware Code. Next election = last regular election + term. No home addresses, phone numbers or emails are recorded.
